Establishment Means Analysis

Native, Introduced, and Invasive Species in GBIF

GBIF Gap Analysis Pipeline

April 13, 2026

Overview

This report analyses the establishment means (native, introduced, invasive, naturalised, uncertain) and occurrence status (present, absent, doubtful, irregular) of species in the national taxonomy backbone and their representation in GBIF.

Understanding these categories is essential for:

  • Correctly interpreting gap analysis results (absent species should not count as “missing”)
  • Prioritising monitoring of native species vs tracking invasive spread
  • Aligning with CBD Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework targets (especially Target 6 on invasive species)

1. Coverage by Establishment Means

The large gap in coverage for unclassified species (those without establishment means in the backbone) is a key finding. These 39,416 species are mostly higher taxa (genera, families) or species with unknown origin. They inflate the overall gap numbers significantly.

Key insight: When filtering to native present species only, GBIF coverage rises from 50.4% to 76.8%.

9. Summary and Recommendations

Key findings:

  • 60,027 native present species — 76.8% have GBIF records

  • 450 invasive species — 73.1% have GBIF records, 121 lack any data

  • 39,416 species lack establishment means classification — these inflate gap numbers (only 6% have GBIF records)

Recommendations:

  1. Use scoped metrics: When reporting coverage statistics, filter to “native present” species for conservation-relevant numbers. The overall 48% coverage figure is misleading because it includes absent, doubtful, and unclassified species.

  2. Monitor invasive species: 121 invasive species have no GBIF occurrence data. These represent blind spots for invasion monitoring and should be prioritised for targeted surveys.

  3. Classify unknown species: 39,416 species lack establishment means. Improving this classification in the national backbone would immediately improve the precision of gap analysis results.

  4. Align with CBD Target 6: Track the rate of invasive species establishment using GBIF occurrence data. The spatial map in Section 6 provides a baseline for monitoring invasive spread over time.
